subject.title: improve(android): move Wear agent, session, and model pickers to Home

question: Should Wear expose agent, session, and model switching as compact Home controls and make the new capability-negotiated Phone proxy contract part of the supported companion experience?
rationale: The patch introduces a new user-facing Wear workflow and two new cross-app RPC methods; test and device evidence can validate implementation, but they cannot choose the permanent navigation and protocol direction.

options.title: Sponsor the Home workflow
options.body: Approve the three Home controls and additive capability contract, subject to the pending Android validation lanes passing.

options.title: Keep separate context pages
options.body: Retain the current navigation model and close or narrow this feature rather than adding model selection to Home.

options.title: Request a narrower model-only change
options.body: Ask for a smaller supported model-selection surface without removing the existing Agent and Session pages.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the Home workflow
recommendation.body: Approve the three Home controls and additive capability contract, subject to the pending Android validation lanes passing.

likelyOwner.reason: The available record only establishes the implementation author as the directly connected person; a current-main Android/Wear owner could not be reliably identified from the available inspection.
